title: content.replace edits module words on a Joomla site Apply wrote in another language, and on every CMS a writable stored place that holds the words is named instead of "do not look for another way in"
steps: S1: Run the sealed-Joomla replace engine on the 1.2.0 inspect fixture rewritten the way Apply leaves a Dutch site (module rows nl-NL, titles still ending in "(en)", page lang nl-nl), replacing the words of module-441.1.
S2: Run it on the same fixture with the module rows left en-GB on the nl-nl page (the anchor misses), then again with at:["module-441.1"].
S3: Run locate with a writable stored place that holds the words and an anchor that rejects it.
S4: Run content.find on a Joomla webroot of 4001 language files that do not hold the words, and on one with 60 files that all do.
S5: On EmDash, ask quotedElsewhere for words a writable stored value holds but the strict region check kept off that spot; then the same with that value unwritable.
expect: S1: the call writes, with module-441.1 in the one apply.
S2: the first call is NOT_EDITABLE whose next is not "do not look for another way in" and whose held lists module-441.1; the at: call writes it.
S3: NOT_EDITABLE with held [{at, label}] and a next that carries at:["<that place>"]; a place with writable:false keeps the plain next.
S4: the first answer's stopped says part of the site is unsearched and never "search a longer phrase"; the second still says "search a longer phrase".

S5: NOT_EDITABLE with held [{at, label}] and a next naming at:["<that value>"]; the unwritable value keeps the plain next ("that is an answer"). WordPress and sealed Joomla reach the core check of S3; open Joomla never answers that next.
evidence: 16/10/2026 local stand (develop b472e98a1), Dutch Tracy Business site deschaar1610: content.replace refused "Elena Gurova · IR Director" (module-860) as words the template prints; the turn took 58 s and 8 steps before content.contract apply wrote it
fence: The engine's store and anchor: a module's language is its row's, and the core never answers "do not look for another way in" while a writable stored place holds the words

tests: 1.2.0 Dutch Apply site: a module's row language wins
1.2.0 an English module on a Dutch page: refused, but the answer names the module
a module whose row names no language still reads it
a writable stored place that holds the words but missed the anchor is named
a walk cut by its file budget says so
EmDash: the words as quoted, held by a writable value the strict region check kept off this spot
